I deposited $2000 of my own money into an account on the trading platform at summit-securities.com ( also using their client dashboard at dashboard.summit-securities.com). After generating profits on the account, I submitted a withdrawal request. The request has not been reviewed or processed in 3 weeks of submitting it. Support has not responded to any messages sent through their website chat support portal and email. The platform markets itself as a fully regulated broker offering forex, CFDs, and related products. Public information on the site shows it relies on a liquidity provider (Marquess Global Ltd) registered in the Union of Comoros (Bonovo Road, Fomboni, Island of Mohéli) under a Mwali International Services Authority (MISA) license. No clear U.S. business address or verifiable major-jurisdiction regulation is provided.
This appears to be a common pattern with high-risk offshore trading platforms that accept deposits but obstruct withdrawals and stop responding once profits are requested.
